description:
Generate AI photos from face images, using a preset theme or a custom prompt. Costs 100 credits per photo. Upload the face photos with upload_image first, and find theme slugs with browse_themes.

Requires a connected Photo AI Studio account. Calling this tool starts the sign-in flow.

category.description: Theme slug from browse_themes, required when type is themed

images.description: CDN URLs of face photos (1-9), from upload_image

prompt.description: Custom prompt, required when type is custom

type.description: themed uses a preset style, custom uses your prompt

wait_for_result.description: Wait up to 55 seconds for the result before returning. Defaults to false: the tool returns a prediction_id immediately and you poll get_prediction, which is the reliable pattern for photos and videos.

name: generate_photo
title: Generate AI photos
